name: Technology assessment
problem: Weighing a new technology means holding options, actors and consequences side by side. A designer made for (constructive) technology assessment lays them out so trade-offs can be seen and argued over, not buried in a document.

name: Humans and agents together
problem: When people and software agents work on the same task, each needs to see what the other is doing and why. A shared, specialized view gives both the same picture of the work and its state.

name: Clarity in textual data
problem: Structure hidden in logs, notes and plain-text formats is hard to see line by line. A designer tuned to one format shows that structure directly, while the text stays the source of truth.

name: Systems and strategy
problem: Systems and strategies are shaped by feedback, dependencies and position, which a list of boxes hides. A designer made for them shows loops, value chains and landscapes as they are, so a decision can be traced to the structure behind it.

name: Knowledge and semantics
problem: Ontologies, vocabularies and linked data are graphs written down as text, and their meaning lives in the links. A designer made for them draws the classes, concepts and relations, so a model can be checked by eye while the file stays the standard.

name: Software delivery
problem: Pipelines, deployments and dependencies are spread over many configuration files, and their order and coupling only show when something breaks. A designer made for software delivery draws them as they run, so a change can be understood before it ships.

name: Planning and roadmapping
problem: Plans are about time, order and what waits on what, and a flat list of items loses all three. A designer made for planning places work on a timeline and draws its dependencies, so overlaps and critical paths show at a glance.

name: Psychological and societal insights
problem: How people and societies respond to change, from hype to adoption to feedback in behaviour, is easy to state and hard to see. A designer made for these insights lays trends and influences out, so patterns can be discussed rather than assumed.
